data.name: StateSchema
data.description: Root schema of the application's global store state. Composes feature slices (counter, user, ui) plus the RTK Query API cache state registered under a dynamic reducerPath key. It also defines the supporting ThunkExtraArg (AxiosInstance api client injected into thunks) and ThunkConfig<T> (typed thunk configuration with state, extra, and rejectValue).

properties.name: counter
properties.description: State slice for the Counter feature

properties.name: user
properties.description: State slice for the User feature (imported from @/entities/User)

properties.name: ui
properties.description: State slice for UI feature state (imported from @/features/UI)

properties.name: [rtkApi.reducerPath]
properties.description: Dynamic key holding RTK Query API cache state, keyed by the rtkApi reducerPath

relationships.description: Global state contains the Counter feature slice
Global state contains the User feature slice
Global state contains the UI feature slice
Global state contains RTK Query cache state under the dynamic rtkApi.reducerPath key

validations: State must include the counter, user, and ui feature slices
API state must be registered under the dynamic key rtkApi.reducerPath so RTK Query caching works
Thunk extra argument (ThunkExtraArg) must expose an api client of type AxiosInstance
Thunks using ThunkConfig<T> must supply a typed rejectValue T for rejection handling

scenarios.name: Store initialization
scenarios.given: Feature reducers for counter, user, and ui plus the rtkApi reducer
scenarios.when: The StoreProvider creates the Redux store
scenarios.then: The resulting store state conforms to StateSchema
and: API cache state is accessible under rtkApi.reducerPath

scenarios.name: Thunk execution with typed config
scenarios.then: It receives state: StateSchema and extra: ThunkExtraArg containing the AxiosInstance api client
and: It can reject with a typed value of T via rejectValue

data.name: Counter
data.description: Represents a simple counter entity holding a single numeric value, used as the state schema for the Counter feature.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The current numeric value of the counter

validations: value is required and must be of type number

data.name: User
data.description: Represents the authenticated user of the application. The User type is defined in src/entities/User/model/types/user. Initialization of auth data (fetching the current user on app startup) is currently a stub (placeholder) that is not yet implemented; planned implementations include cookie/session (GET /auth/me), JWT (token check with refresh), or OAuth (code-for-token exchange).
validations: initAuthData thunk must either resolve with a User object or reject with an error string
The concrete shape of User properties is not visible in the provided sources and cannot be verified

scenarios.name: Initialize auth data (stub not implemented)
scenarios.given: Application startup dispatches the user/initAuthData thunk
scenarios.when: the thunk executes in its current stub form
scenarios.then: it rejects with the value 'Не реализовано' (Not implemented)

scenarios.name: Auth initialization error handling
scenarios.given: The future real auth initialization request throws an exception
scenarios.then: it rejects with 'Ошибка инициализации авторизации' (Auth initialization error)

scenarios.name: Initialize auth data once implemented
scenarios.given: The thunk is implemented to call GET /auth/me via the injected api
scenarios.then: the returned User data is dispatched as the fulfilled payload

data.name: UISchema
data.description: Represents the UI state schema for the application, tracking scroll positions per page address.

properties.name: scroll
properties.description: Map of page addresses to their saved scroll positions

relationships.description: UISchema contains a ScrollSchema map under its 'scroll' property

validations: scroll must be a record object mapping page address keys to numeric values
Each scroll position value must be a number

scenarios.name: Save scroll position for a page
scenarios.given: A user has scrolled a page to a given offset
scenarios.when: The scroll position is recorded in the UI schema
scenarios.then: The scroll map contains an entry keyed by the page address with the numeric scroll offset as its value

scenarios.name: Look up scroll position for a page
scenarios.given: The scroll map contains an entry for a specific page address
scenarios.when: The page address is looked up in the scroll map
scenarios.then: The saved numeric scroll offset for that address is returned

data.name: ScrollSchema
data.description: A record mapping page addresses (URLs/paths) to their scroll positions expressed as numeric offsets.

properties.name: pageAddress
properties.description: The page address used as the record key identifying a visited page

properties.name: scrollPosition
properties.description: The numeric scroll position (offset) associated with the page address

relationships.description: ScrollSchema is embedded as the 'scroll' property of UISchema

validations: Keys must be page address strings and unique within the record
Values must be numbers representing scroll positions

scenarios.name: Record scroll offset for a page address
scenarios.given: The scroll record for the application UI state
scenarios.when: A page at address '/articles' is scrolled to offset 500
scenarios.then: The ScrollSchema entry maps '/articles' to the number 500

scenarios.name: Independent entries per page address
scenarios.given: Scroll positions saved for multiple page addresses
scenarios.when: Each page address is queried in the record
scenarios.then: Each address returns its own independent numeric scroll position
